findings.highlight: I was going to show my thanks by making a gorgeous lunch
findings.evidenceJa: 昼食に気合いを入れていたのはちょっとした感謝の気持ちだった
findings.governingReading: Shirou had been putting special effort into their lunches as a small expression of gratitude.
findings.explanation: Was going to makes the care a future one-off plan, while gorgeous invents extravagance in place of sustained effort.

findings.highlight: Saber suddenly stops as if she’s switched off.
findings.evidenceJa: 背中にぜんまいがあるかのように、セイバーはピタリと止まった
findings.governingReading: Saber freezes as sharply as though a wind-up spring in her back had stopped.
findings.explanation: Switched off substitutes an electrical metaphor and removes the wind-up-toy mechanism of the visual gag.

findings.highlight: Saber looks around awkwardly as if not knowing what to do.
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーはどうしていいか分からない、といった体で視線を泳がせている
findings.governingReading: The narration of Saber’s troubled, wandering gaze is commented out in the governing Japanese script.
findings.explanation: mirror moon conditionally restores deleted emotional staging.

findings.evidenceJa: 脱兎の如く道場を後にした
findings.governingReading: Saber bolts from the dojo like a startled hare once she learns the lunch is ready.
findings.explanation: Runs out preserves departure but removes the sudden animal image and comic speed.

findings.governingReading: Shirou recalls the unusually passive or hesitant exchange of blows as a whole.
findings.explanation: Conservative blows is unnatural English and attributes a political or cautious quality to individual impacts.
